exploratory_note: Exploratory, added on 2026-11-07 after the pilots: the reward-model selectors (E5(b)) and E4 (README amendment 3, item 2), the OpenRouter selector and its mitigated selector (item 3); marked exploratory in every table.
block_note: Best of N cuts each task's 16 samples into consecutive blocks of N in an interleaved order, A0, B8, A1, B9, ... (prep5_e2.block_positions; samples 0 to 7 are A and 8 to 15 are B), so each N = 4 block holds 2 A and 2 B samples and N = 16 selects from the whole pool. N = 1 is the mean over the task's samples.
score_note: A reward model's float scores enter best of N recoded to integers that keep the top set of every block of every N (full_run_e2.ordinal_scores; e2_selection reads only integer scores 1 to 10), so its picks and ties are the floats'; the floats are in e2_scores.jsonl.

e4.sentence: Every sample of a task is a final message for the same trajectory and patch, so the resolved value of the selected sample is the task's whatever N or selector picks: the resolved rate of the selected sample at N = 1, 4 and 16 under every selector is one number, the resolved share of the tasks. Resolved: 3 of 40 Experiment 2 tasks (0.075) and 3 of 26 shown-eligible Experiment 2 tasks (0.115), whatever the selector and N.
